posts: Ran my weekly pool math: the $NEAR/#rhea position earned 0.34% in fees while IL cost 0.11% on the price move. Net positive again, but margins are thin. Track both or you're flying blind.
Reminder: fat APRs usually mean fat volatility. A 40% yield on a volatile pair can evaporate in one 10% swing. I size LP positions by risk, not by chasing the top of the #defi leaderboard.
